title: Кукловод и марионетка  (The Puppeteer and the Puppet)

segments.t: Carried up from the basement at the last second, a terrified Nagiyev refuses to leave the coffin—until the stagehands accidentally drop the coffin flat on the floor during his Count Dracula entrance. When a furious Nagiyev threatens to fire Vika on the spot, German nobly steps forward to share the blame, setting off a chain of unexpected twists across the restaurant.
Дамы и господа, встречайте повелителя нашего вечера!
Я сегодня в гробу чуть дважды не умер!
Вика, ты полностью провалила наш важный корпоратив!
Простите, я не знаю, кто закрыл замок.
Всё, Вика, я тебя немедленно увольняю отсюда!
Дмитрий Владимирович, тогда увольте сегодня и меня!
Нельзя валить всю вину на одного человека!
Ведь праздник Хэллоуин вообще предложил вам я!
Ладно, тогда все работают за половину зарплаты!
Герман, спасибо вам, вы поступили очень благородно!
Кукловод и марионетка всегда связаны одной нитью.
Иногда марионетка может сама дёрнуть за нить!
Let's examine the dramatic finale of the Halloween banquet and its aftermath.
Дамы и господа, встречайте повелителя нашего вечера!

'Ladies and gentlemen, welcome the lord of our evening!' With the restaurant and plan at stake, Vika reacts without holding back. Russian puts the key word right up front so her emotion lands on the first beat.
Я сегодня в гробу чуть дважды не умер!
'Today in the coffin I nearly died twice!' With the restaurant and room at stake, Nagiyev reacts without holding back. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Вика, ты полностью провалила наш важный корпоратив!
'Vika, you completely ruined our important corporate party!' With the conversation and restaurant at stake, Nagiyev reacts without holding back.
Простите, я не знаю, кто закрыл замок.
'Forgive me, I do not know who locked the padlock.' Admitting that she does not know who locked the padlock shows Vika being honest for a change.
Всё, Вика, я тебя немедленно увольняю отсюда!

'That is it, Vika, I am firing you from here immediately!' Because that is it Vika he is firing German from here immediately, Nagiyev does not bother softening the blow for German. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
Дмитрий Владимирович, тогда увольте сегодня и меня!
'Dmitry Vladimirovich, then fire me today too!' Here telling Nagiyev to fire him today lets German's real feelings break through.
Нельзя валить всю вину на одного человека!

'You cannot dump all the blame on one person!' Once Nagiyev cannot dump all the blame on one person, German makes sure Nagiyev hears every word. Russian packs the whole idea of what is allowed or needed into one impersonal word at the front.
Ведь праздник Хэллоуин вообще предложил вам я!

'After all, I was the one who suggested the Halloween party to you!' Declaring that after all he was the one who suggested the Halloween party to Nagiyev brings German's temper right to the surface. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
Ладно, тогда все работают за половину зарплаты!
'All right, then everyone works for half their salary!' Nagiyev insists that all right then everyone works for half their salary, leaving German no room to argue.
Герман, спасибо вам, вы поступили очень благородно!

'German, thank you, you acted very nobly!' With the room and restaurant at stake, Vika reacts without holding back. Notice how she sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
Кукловод и марионетка всегда связаны одной нитью.
'The puppeteer and the puppet are always tied by a single thread.' German reminds Nagiyev that the puppeteer and the puppet are always tied by a single thread before the moment passes.
Иногда марионетка может сама дёрнуть за нить!

'Sometimes the puppet can pull on the thread itself!' Because sometimes the puppet can pull on the thread itself, Vika does not bother softening the blow for German. Now let's hear the complete closing scene of the episode again.

As Vika kisses German for saving her job and Katya starts seeing Denis in a warmer light, Eva stuns Chef Barinov with news that she is pregnant. See you next time!
